title: GeneralConfig
description: Top-level nico-api service configuration. All fields live under the [general] TOML section.

listen.description: Socket address for the gRPC API server. Clients and nico-admin-cli connect here.

listen_only.description: Run passively — no background services, only RPC/web connections. Used in dev mode when a second nico instance runs against a cluster that already has a full instance.

metrics_endpoint.description: Socket address for the HTTP server serving Prometheus metrics under /metrics. Omit to disable metrics.

alt_metric_prefix.description: Alternative metric prefix emitted alongside carbide_ during dashboard migrations. Increases observability system load; remove once migration is complete.

database_url.description: Postgres connection string for all persistent state. The password is typically injected via the CARBIDE_API_DATABASE_URL environment variable rather than stored in this file.

max_database_connections.description: Maximum size of the database connection pool.

database_pool_acquire_timeout.description: How long a caller may wait for a connection from the pool before failing. Trips on a stalled database or saturated pool.

database_pool_idle_timeout.description: How long a pooled connection may sit unused before the pool closes it. Should be well inside the Postgres server's idle-session timeout (typically 60 minutes).

database_pool_max_lifetime.description: Maximum age of a pooled connection before it is replaced. Keeps the pool rebalancing onto the current primary after a database failover.

asn.description: Autonomous System Number, fixed per environment. Used by nico-dpu-agent to write frr.conf for BGP routing.

dhcp_servers.description: DHCP server IPv4 addresses announced to DPUs during network provisioning.

ntp_servers.description: NTP server IPv4 addresses for the site.

route_servers.description: Route server IP addresses for L2VPN (Ethernet Virtual) network support on DPUs.

enable_route_servers.description: Enable route server injection into DPU FRR configs for L2VPN Ethernet Virtual networks.

deny_prefixes.description: IPv4 CIDR prefixes that tenant instances are not permitted to communicate with.

site_fabric_prefixes.description: IPv4 and IPv6 CIDR prefixes assigned for tenant use within this site.

anycast_site_prefixes.description: Aggregate IPv4 CIDR prefixes containing tenant-assigned prefixes that the DPU may announce (e.g. BYOIP).

common_tenant_host_asn.description: ASN allocated for tenants peering with the DPU. When unset, remote-as external is used, allowing any ASN.

vpc_isolation_behavior.description: VPC isolation policy enforced on tenant traffic.

host_naming_strategy.description: Strategy for deriving machine hostnames. Only 'fun' preserves existing real names; others re-derive on reconcile.

attestation_enabled.description: Require machine attestation before a machine can transition from Discovered to Ready. Introduces the Measuring state. Roll out per-site after verifying the Scout image supports Action::MEASURE.

tpm_required.description: Require a TPM module for machine registration. When false, the chassis serial is used as the stable machine identifier instead.

bypass_rbac.description: Disable role-based access control enforcement. For testing and development only.

max_find_by_ids.description: Maximum number of IDs accepted by find_*_by_ids APIs to prevent oversized queries.

bmc_session_lockout_threshold.description: Number of consecutive HTTP 401/403 responses from a BMC before the session-token path stops attempting to log in, to avoid exhausting the BMC root account retry budget.

allow_bmc_basic_auth_fallback.description: When true, GetBmcCredentials may return UsernamePassword credentials for BMCs whose Redfish ServiceRoot does not expose SessionService.

initial_dpu_agent_upgrade_policy.description: Initial policy for deciding whether a nico-dpu-agent should be upgraded. Overridable via nico-admin-cli.

initial_domain_name.description: Domain to create if no domains exist. Most sites use a single domain for their lifetime.

sitename.description: Human-readable site name exposed to tenant OS via the FMDS endpoint.

internet_l3_vni.description: Network infrastructure-provided L3 VNI for FNN VPC Internet connectivity. Combined with datacenter_asn to form a route-target.

datacenter_asn.description: Datacenter ASN used by FNN to build DC-specific route targets for VRF import and export.

x86_pxe_boot_url_override.description: Override PXE boot URL for x86 machines.

arm_pxe_boot_url_override.description: Override PXE boot URL for ARM machines.

external_api_url.description: Alternate API URL for external hosts that cannot resolve the internal hostname. Use an IP or externally resolvable hostname.

external_pxe_url.description: Alternate PXE URL for external hosts, used for cloud-init and root CA retrieval.

external_static_pxe_url.description: Alternate static PXE URL for external hosts, used for kernel/blob downloads. Falls back to external_pxe_url when unset.

initial_objects_file.description: Path to initial_objects.toml for seeding the database.

min_dpu_functioning_links.description: Minimum functioning DPU links required for the DPU to be considered healthy. When unset, all links must be functional.

site_global_vpc_vni.description: Force all VRFs to use this VNI. Required on sites where Cumulus Linux route-leaking limits VRF count to one.

rack_management_enabled.description: Use nico as a standalone infrastructure manager for racks of GB200/GB300/VR144 via Rack Manager. Changes site controller behavior significantly.

enable_admin_ui.description: Serve the admin web UI at /admin. When false, only the gRPC API is available.

dhcp_lease_expiry_handling.description: Clean up IP allocations when DHCP leases expire.

dpu_network_monitor_pinger_type.description: Pinger implementation used by the DPU network monitor to health-check DPU links.

retained_boot_interface_window.description: How long a retained boot interface pair stays applicable after its machine_interfaces row was deleted. Omit to retain forever.

default_tenant_routing_profile_type.description: Default routing profile assigned when a tenant is created.

compute_allocation_enforcement.description: Controls compute allocation enforcement when a new instance is requested.
